{{Quote|I'm looking for information.''"<br />"''And I'm looking for a wild night out interspersed with one to three pulse-pounding death-defying dust-ups.|A bounty hunter and Dekk'lar|audio=Dekklar.flac|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Dekk'lar''' was<ref name="TOR" /> a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Dekk'lar had [[Color/Legends|blue]] eyes and skin and was [[Clothing/Legends|clothed]] in a black and white armored jacket, red pants, and a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
In the latter half of [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref> Dekk'lar was present near a [[Hologame table/Legends|hologame table]] inside a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] when they were approached by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on contract with the [[Bounty Brokers Association]]. Dekk'lar was requested to provide information about a criminal that the hunter was searching for. For a moment, Dekk'lar flirted with the hunter before supplying the needed information.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dekk'lar appeared in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], an expansion to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', during the recurring Bounty Contract Week event<ref name="TOR" /> introduced in Game Update 2.3 in [[2013]].<ref name="2.3">{{TORweb/Patch|2.3}}</ref> The event is available to players aligned with either the Republic or the Empire and features Dekk'lar as one of several rotating characters that are randomly selected to appear during the event's Bounty Contract daily missions. The missions can take place on a variety of randomly selected worlds, including [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Voss]]. Dekk'lar has the potential to appear at any of these locations, but is always found in a cantina and can be summoned by the player by interacting with a hologame table.<ref name="TOR" />

Dekk'lar and their female counterpart, [[Kelia Freen]], were created to be brief romance options with player characters of any gender as they progress through the Bounty Contract missions.<ref name="TOR" /> Dekk'lar is known as "charming_rogue" in the game's files.<ref name="Dekk'lar">While not visible in-game, Dekk'lar's internal name in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' can be seen here: {{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/dekklar|text=Dekk'lar|work=[[Jedipedia]].net's SWTOR Database|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/wip/ASZqZ}}</ref>

The cutscene in which Dekk'lar appears opens with him flirting with the player. The player is then presented with [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]], [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], and neutral response options. The player can choose to reason with or threaten Dekk'lar by selecting the light side and dark side options respectively. The neutral response option allows players to reciprocate Dekk'lar's advances. Regardless of the choice made, Dekk'lar provides the player with the information necessary to progress in the mission.<ref name="TOR" />
